text:
alex: Customer reported parser failure in JSON mode. They say our response contains an unescaped literal newline in product_description and their parser chokes. Correlation ID: cor-7f9b2

alex: sample from logs:
```json
{
  "id": "rec_123",
  "product_name": "Trailmix Pro",
  "product_description": "Lightweight, durable\nwith weatherproof zipper",
  "price": 49.99
}
```

maya: that's an unescaped newline inside the string? Looks okay in logs (\n) but customer sees a literal newline. any chance streaming/truncation changed escapes? Can you paste the raw bytes or curl that reproduced it?

josh: oncall check: I pulled request payload and server response for cor-7f9b2. The response in logs had a raw LF (0x0A) inside the JSON string, which makes it invalid JSON for strict parsers. Logging snippet:
```
RESPONSE_RAW: {"id":"rec_123","product_name":"Trailmix Pro","product_description":"Lightweight, durable
with weatherproof zipper","price":49.99}
```

infra-bot: Logs linked: https://logs.redwood.internal/requests/cor-7f9b2 (ingest complete)

maya: repro steps I used:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-astro-1","json_mode":true,"prompt":"generate product json"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
I got properly escaped \n with same prompt. Maybe depends on model variant or streaming vs non-streaming.

lina: quick mitigation we offered to customer: ask them to set their client to tolerant parsing (replace unescaped newlines inside quotes) or use our SDK option `parse_relaxed: true` which we can enable on their account immediately. I sent the workaround and committed to a patch.

alex: SLA update to customer: initial workaround provided, we will roll a server-side sanitizer to escape stray LFs within strings in 48h. ETA for patch to staging 12h, canary 24-36h, full deploy 48h. I told them we'll follow up every 4 hours until resolved.

maya: root cause hypothesis: model generation sometimes emits literal newline token when prompt template includes raw newlines or when generating multi-line descriptions. When streaming, the runtime concatenates token text without re-escaping. Plan: add an output sanitizer at the serving layer that re-escapes control chars before returning JSON when json_mode=true. Also add an eval test in model onboarding to catch unescaped control chars.

josh: I'll take the patch, add unit tests, and coordinate canary. tagging @infra to ensure no perf regression.

infra-bot: Deploy job queued: deploy/patch-escape-json-1782-1 (ETA staging 11:30 UTC)

lina: I'll update the customer thread with the timeline and attach the curl repro and the support ticket id: S-8893. Thanks team :thumbsup:
